en.heroTitle: Vermicompost for Nurseries & Saplings — Bulk Supply
en.heroLead: Nursery growers need repeatable quality for potting mixes, saplings, and transplant survival. Satva vermicompost supports fruit plants, vegetable seedlings, ornamentals, and forestry nurseries with 1 kg trials through bulk supply.

sectionsBeforeTable.title: Why Nurseries Choose Satva
paragraphs: Seedling media needs stable organic matter without burning tender roots. Vermicompost improves texture, moisture retention, and early root development when mixed at 10–20% of growing media.
Bulk nursery programmes benefit from batch consistency, clean 50 kg bags, and direct support from our Mohali team.

table.title: Nursery Application Guide
table.intro: Adjust ratios for crop and media type. Heavy peat mixes may need lower percentages.

items.label: Bulk:
items.text: Large propagation units and institutional buyers.

faqs.question: Is vermicompost safe for delicate seedlings?
faqs.answer: Yes, when well-matured and used at recommended mix rates. Avoid raw or unfinished compost in seedling trays.

faqs.question: Can we get repeat monthly supply?
faqs.answer: Yes. Discuss volume and district with us for scheduled supply and wholesale rates.

faqs.question: Do you supply to UP and HP nurseries?
faqs.answer: Yes. We serve North India nursery clusters with freight coordinated on enquiry.

cta.description: Share your nursery location and monthly volume range.

थोक कार्यक्रमों के लिए सुसंगत बैच और 50 किलो बैग।
